results.name: Browser and CommonJS builds expose the same API
Every day has three goals, one in Rush, one puzzle and one to explore, the same for everyone
Goals read plainly and every one points at a place to play it
The day picks stay the same as before for everyone
Saying hi to a meadow friend finishes the meadow goal and nothing else
A meadow goal saved before the change loads unchanged
Rush blooms add up across runs, while the wave and chain goals keep the best run
Puzzle goals count clears in any garden mode; stars, daily, Moon and Koi each count only their own
A goal completes once; finishing all three gives the bonus once
A new day starts fresh, and damaged or forged saves cannot mark a goal done
The garden pays 4 seeds per goal and a 6-seed bonus, once per day and slot
